description: Node convention: the callback is the last argument and receives `(error, value)`; `error` is `null` on success.
A callback API must call back once per invocation. Missing `return`s and `try` blocks around the callback cause double calls.
An API that is sometimes synchronous and sometimes asynchronous. Always call callbacks asynchronously to keep ordering predictable.
Turns an error-first callback function into one that returns a promise. Supports `util.promisify.custom`.
The reverse: wraps an async function so callback-based code can call it.
A rejected promise nobody handles. Node 15+ crashes the process by default.
Stable string on Node system errors (`ENOENT`, `EACCES`, `EEXIST`). Branch on it, never on the message.
